scope: Exploratory preparation; no optimization or prospectively frozen workload experiment.
limitations: Intermediate analyzer sources were edited during exploration and not all historical revisions were retained. The historical diagnostic JSON files are not claimed reproducible with the final analyzer.
Initial probe builds were exploratory. The final portable v2 has explicit build/replay logs and before/after source identities.
The first byte-level SequenceMatcher attempt was stopped; it is not a measurement.
The final analyzer remains a lexer for bound valid fixtures, not a general XML safety or publication proof. Independent namespace-aware exact-gap evidence supplies the locality check.
